findings.reason: the author would cite `remote.py` as the push convention the copy follows, and would see that the keys §18 leaves unnamed (machine slug, ambix commit, tree digest) already have a modelled set to align with.
findings.text: §18 says "The registry calls follow imas-codex's GHCR layer, `imas_codex/graph/ghcr.py`" and enumerates only `list_registry_tags`, `fetch_tag_messages`, `login_to_ghcr` and `require_oras`, but `ghcr.py` carries no `oras push`; the push with its annotation convention lives at `imas_codex/graph/remote.py:1040`, `:1083-1091`, `:1195` and `:1302` (`oras push` with `--annotation org.opencontainers.image.version=`, `io.imas-codex.git-commit=` and `org.opencontainers.image.description=`, plus `oras tag <ref> latest`) — pitched against nothing, so the plan proposes a push whose annotation keys and artifact-type convention already exist uncited in a sibling module

findings.reason: the `pull` signature must name the override flag (as §8's `write` names `--overwrite`) or the refusal, and the local-only work it guards, cannot be resolved without hand-editing the tree.
findings.text: §18 declares `pull <machine> [--version] [--dest DIR]` and then states "It refuses to overwrite a local tree whose digest matches no released tag unless told to", but no option in the declared signature tells it to: there is no `--force`/`--overwrite` anywhere in the section (`grep -n "force|overwrite" plan.html` finds only §8's unrelated `write --overwrite`), so the one refusal the section accounts for is unescapable and `pull` into `maps/<machine>/` becomes a lock-out exactly when the local tree holds the unreleased map edits the refusal exists to protect

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §18 hides the state machine, the tag-list ordering, the digest computation, the registry layer and the push/pull behind three commands in one `imas_ambix/maps_cli.py`; §19 hides the struct-array index behind one `WrittenLeaf` field.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — §18 merges `packages/imas-alambic/README?install/imasdb.sh`'s private `oras pull` into `maps pull <machine>` and keeps the machine-to-package name in one table in `imas_ambix/data/paths.py` beside `MAPS_DIR` (paths.py:35), so no second owner of the registry path or package name is created.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §18's "Accounting for the new surface" paragraph names what §19 and §18 retire, but the `pull` surface it declares omits the option its own refusal depends on.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §18 cites `imas_codex/graph/ghcr.py` as the GHCR layer its registry calls follow, enumerating four read/auth helpers, but the `oras push` it must implement (artifact type plus push annotations) already has an owner it does not cite: `imas_codex/graph/remote.py`.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §18 states why the four GHCR helpers are copied rather than imported (ambix does not depend on imas-codex, and `imas_codex/graph/__init__.py` executes `ensure_models_fresh()` and imports the Neo4j `GraphClient`), and §18 retired the earlier `release_if_changed` helper in favour of the digest-guarded automatic call.
